method.enumeration: fresh direct Google Drive list_folder over root and all eight direct child folders plus all seven nested folders, top_k=1000; no call hit ceiling
method.classification_basis: path family + MIME/type + role in source tree; representative/high-value semantic families deep-read from primary files
method.rule: Every leaf receives exactly one operational disposition. Versioned visual outputs and content-addressed cache/store entries are accounted structurally but receive no independent semantic/earned-work credit. Binary SQLite plus readable SQL projections are one state family, not independent knowledge claims.

findings: Global Workspace is a cognitive integration path, not UI; component existence is insufficient without process-crossing re-entry and competing consumers.
Historical source reports only 4 of 16 listed consumers actually read workspace_broadcast, an under-connectivity failure.
Workspace pipeline uses salience competition, ignition threshold 0.55, focused vs compressed channels and durable DB re-entry.
Source separates exact numeric machine state, word-level workspace projection, and slowly learned weights/dispositions.
Historical latency numbers are source-reported and were not reproduced in this run.
Compact projection preserves K6 workspace channels, EPQ5, THAL9, NAC9, novelty annotations and the 4-of-16 consumer warning.
Allowed transitions are explicit; not every describable state is legal.
kern.db is designated one truth; a second state store is forbidden because display and execution divergence becomes a lie.
Judged/terminal evidence is immutable; rework is a new run.
Workers finish own open packet before taking new work; closure requires measured after-value/token and independent Chef remeasurement.
Visible coordination and actual agent/session work must use the same authoritative source.
No permanent render loop; objective idle oracle is zero requestAnimationFrame passes after settle.
Three prototypes A/B/C share identical test states and are selected by measured material realism, FPS/main-thread cost, runtime size and 100-random-interaction robustness.
If a hard visual requirement is too expensive, report measured evidence and fallback instead of silently omitting it.
18 exact app surfaces map endpoint groups explicitly.
Missing sources and failures must remain visible rather than fabricated or silently empty.
Before/after measurement is mandatory; source reports S5 baseline 4 of 55 endpoint groups = 0.07.

current_architecture_feedback.rule: Display/readout and execution/session state must derive from the same authoritative source; test divergence explicitly.
Do not PASS a Global Workspace because a module exists. Require multiple independent consumers, re-entry receipts and demonstrable downstream behavior change.
Terminal judged/verified evidence is immutable; rework creates a new lineage/run instead of rewriting the old result.
Performance/capability completion requires before/after measurements or task-grounded proof; self-report alone cannot close a claim.
Event-driven visual/processing components must settle to an explicit idle oracle; no permanent polling/render loop without evidence-based necessity.
Needle should expose scoped transitions over one authoritative execution/state surface; UI/model projections are read views, not competing stores.
Keep exact machine state, bounded model-facing qualitative projection, and slow learned dispositions as distinct layers with provenance and promotion tests.
The repo-native RAE must not call a state surface global merely because it is written. Track actual organ consumers, re-entry and causal behavior changes.

falsifiers: If a replicated same-source-vs-projected-store experiment shows no detectable divergence risk under failures/restarts, the single-authority constraint may be relaxed only with explicit consistency semantics.
If a workspace with one consumer outperforms multi-consumer competition/re-entry on held-out causal tasks, the GWT fan-out requirement should be revised rather than preserved by analogy.
If permanent polling/render loops are measurably cheaper and equally recoverable than event-driven quiescence on target hardware for a specific subsystem, allow that subsystem by measured exception.
If number/word/weight separation causes loss of task-critical precision in held-out FRANK interactions, redesign the projection rather than leaking all raw state into model context.

credit.semantic_credit_policy: family/mechanism level only; generated/version/cache/binary replicas do not multiply credit
